aiResearchSummary.text: Deako is researching user‑upgradeable load control and modular lighting systems. In User-upgradeable load control, a modular control unit with a backplate and contact elements controls power to load devices. Systems and methods for networked occupancy prediction describe modular control units defining detection zones and sharing occupancy data. Configurable modular devices and configurable devices focus on swappable wiring, LED light engine encodings, wireless network diagnostics, power transfer and replaceable modules, covering upgradeable control, occupancy sensing and modular lighting.
